Image 1 is the exact coordinate/layout guide for this patch r07_c07/s01_02_native01; Only this exact guide is provided; its field of view is fixed. Fill precisely image 1's field of view at exactly 1254 x 1254. World box [25485, 24461, 26739, 25715], center core crop [115,115,1139,1139]. Sharp existing native CORE anchor bands at image-1 pixel boxes [[0, 0, 1254, 115], [1139, 115, 1254, 1139], [0, 1139, 115, 1254], [115, 1139, 1139, 1254], [1139, 1139, 1254, 1254]] are authoritative neighboring artwork; preserve their line positions, color, stone/wood scale and continuation. The blurry remainder supplies geometry only: render fresh crisp native details throughout that area. Continue all crossing edges smoothly with unchanged scale and camera, without rectangular borders or shifted intersections. This patch shows the gray stone architectural support/foundation between the NORTH paved surface, EAST stone pier and SOUTH vertical gray post. Continue the exact tiny diamond paving and diagonal grout entering from TOP for a short natural depth before a realistic pale stone coping/step turns down into the vertical gray stone facade below. The paving must not simply stop at y115. Center contains the narrow pale-gray vertical support near x450..640, aligned exactly with the bottom guide, and broader gray block face at left; right continues pale stone platform and the restrained red base trim near y900 from the east. Match all bottom vertical edges and right masonry joints. Keep the large quiet gray stone faces and soft shading. No doors, text, lanterns, new gold ornament or additional objects. Warm hand-painted natural pale gray/blue-gray ground, jade/teal architectural accents where shown, restrained warm gold, subtle soft natural daytime shading matching anchors. Preserve the approved layout and existing objects only. No added people, writing, UI, new decorative items, trees, lamps or buildings. No lettering, crop marks, watermarks, fake detail from enlargement, blur, haze or dense noise. Output only the finished full square patch, no collage or comparison.
